rimBuild.title: 1. RIM BUILD
rimBuild.body: Rim builds combine the selected rim profile, drilling pattern, surface finish, and inspection requirements into one controlled production flow.

wheelsetBuild.title: 2. WHEELSET BUILD
wheelsetBuild.body: Wheelset builds coordinate rims, hubs, spokes, nipples, and lacing details so the finished set meets the requested fit and performance targets.

carbonSpokeBuild.title: 3. CARBON SPOKE BUILD
carbonSpokeBuild.body: Carbon spoke builds require controlled preparation, careful tension management, and final checks to maintain reliable performance across the complete wheel system.
